text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A day off. On the course, I spotted 
Symboli Kris S and Fine Motion diligent in 
voluntary training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Time to... wrap up.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, already? That's unusual for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Originally... a rest day. Limiting 
it... to avoid getting rusty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A little later, while I was browsing 
race-related materials in the library—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...... ...Pardon me... that book...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...When you are finished... may I see it? 
...Need it... for research.
choice_data_list:
Sure, but researching races even on your 
day off?

Sure, but researching races even on a day 
off?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...It is my duty.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Inputting the latest materials on days 
off. It's Kris S's routine, you see♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Information, and common sense... 
constantly change. Research is... vital.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Kris S always prioritizes duty. Even 
on days off, that doesn't change at all, 
does it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
......You understand now, Fine. 
Accompanying me on my days off... is 
not... enjoyable.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? It's immensely informative, 
and besides, just spending time like this 
together is delightful!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S remained stoic even on her 
day off. She continued analyzing her own 
data and footage of prominent rival horse 
girls, but then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Suddenly, Symboli Kris S literally came 
to a complete "halt."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Today's routine is... complete. 
...Transitioning to rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Actions irrelevant... to mission 
execution... are unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Do you think so? Perhaps there are 
still other things worth doing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look. Both you and I are international 
students, right? We are here to be hosted 
and learn from this country for a limited 
period of time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Not just about racing... experiencing 
Japanese culture is also one of our 
essential duties, don't you think!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......A valid point. However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: For example――what should we do?
choice_data_list:
...How about visiting some famous Japanese 
sights?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If so, then definitely ramen, the pinnacle 
of popular cuisine, desu wa! The cafeteria 
is serving a special limited-time light 
salt ramen right now♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Come now, take a sip of the soup first! 
Here is a soup spoon, please go ahead♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Rich flavors are... not my 
forte――however――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This――uses good water―― Soft water――is it 
spring water――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you can tell?! I heard they were 
exceptionally particular about the water 
used for both the noodles and the soup, 
desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This is――delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S was able to touch upon 
Japanese culture, if only a little, and 
seemed to spend a day off that felt 
distinctly refreshing compared to usual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――There is no time. I must return――to the 
dorms by curfew.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry about that! I'll charter 
a helicopter right away!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――What?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, ushered aboard a 
helicopter... she found herself suddenly 
embarking on a sightseeing journey.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Quite――reckless. Though――we made it before 
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still, we were able to visit so many 
places together, from the sea to the 
mountains and even the hot springs! Fufu, 
that was so much fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It was――a good day off. ――...Thank you.
